name: yamlet-pi
description: Spec-driven development with yamlet for the pi coding agent: the yamlet CLI registered as first-class pi tools, with a gate that blocks hand-editing a .yamlet.yaml, an interviewing author skill, and two adversarial challengers guarding the one-way init and commit gates. Requires the `yamlet` CLI on PATH; the challengers additionally require @tintinweb/pi-subagents.
